settings.section_text: Curious but have commitment issues? For new to FireCreek Snacks customers, this is the deal for you. You get one stick of each: Original, Kicker, Sweet Heat BBQ & Teriyaki. Our meat sticks are smoked over real hickory and shipped to your door. Taste the whole lineup before you commit to a thing.

settings.grid_box_text: The one that started it all. Clean beef & pork, real hickory smoke, nothing you can't pronounce. A handshake in snack form.
A right hook of jalapeño & red pepper. Enough heat to wake you up — not enough to send you crying to the milk carton.
Smoky-sweet up front, a slow ember on the finish. A backyard cookout you can keep in your pocket.
Savory, a little sweet, unapologetically umami. The fancy one — but it'd never brag about it.

settings.section_heading: Hickory smoked with real smoke — not liquid.

settings.box_text: Beef and pork sourced from U.S. farms. We know where it comes from, and so do you.

7g of protein. Clean since day one.
